turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning! I'm going to be your anesthesiologist for your laparoscopic cholecystectomy tomorrow. I'd like to go through some questions to make sure we're all set for your surgery. Can you start by telling me a bit about why you're having this surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Sure. I've been having pain on the right side of my tummy, especially after eating. The doctor found a gallstone, and they said it's best to remove the gallbladder laparoscopically.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you. That helps. Now, let's go through your medications. I see you're on Atorvastatin, Lisinopril, Omeprazole, and Paracetamol as needed. Can you confirm if you're still taking all of these, and if not, when did you stop any of them?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm still taking Atorvastatin, Lisinopril, and Omeprazole every day. But I stopped taking Paracetamol already. I think it was about six months ago when my back pain got better.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great, thanks for clarifying that. Do you have any allergies? I see penicillin listed with a rash.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, I had a rash when I took penicillin before, so I avoid it. No other drug allergies that I know of.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understood. Are you currently on any other medications, supplements, or herbal remedies that aren't listed here?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I don't think so. Just the ones we already mentioned.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Let's talk about your health. You have a history of hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and you're a bit overweight. How have those been managed lately?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: My blood pressure has been okay, not too high. I take Lisinopril regularly. Cholesterol is under control with Atorvastatin. And I know I need to lose some weight, but it's been hard.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thanks. Have you had any previous surgeries or anesthesia? Any problems with anesthesia in the past?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I had my wisdom teeth removed years ago, and that went fine. No problems with the anesthesia then.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Are you currently on a NPO order? When was the last time you ate or drank anything?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I was told not to eat after midnight. I had some water until about 6 AM this morning, but nothing else.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Perfect. Lastly, how would you describe your overall energy level and ability to perform daily activities?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I can do most things, but sometimes I get a bit tired, especially after meals. But I can walk, climb stairs, that sort of thing.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for all that information. We'll be using general anesthesia with a breathing tube for your surgery. We'll also give you some pain relief during and after surgery. Any questions for me?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I think that's all clear. I'm ready.
